annotations.title: Every holder of a tokenized stock (paid)

description: Every holder of one tokenized stock, from the register rebuilt from its transfers since deployment: balance, value at the issuer’s reference, share outside the issuer’s own wallets, and transfer counts, largest first (up to 2,000). PAID per call, $0.10 over x402 (USDC on Base) or with a plan; concentration and the largest holders are free in stock_check.
